audit_method.proof_critical_definition: A use enters the obligation set iff excluding an induced P6 (or invoking a P6-free algorithm/subgraph property) is logically used to force an adjacency/nonadjacency, exclude a configuration, preserve a graph class, establish equivalence/correctness, or obtain the stated complexity/reconstruction guarantee.
audit_method.decorative_definition: A statement-only ambient P6-free hypothesis or wrapper/transitive reference with no new independent P6-sensitive inference is not an obligation node.
audit_method.grouping_rule: Multiple explicit P6 sequences within one local proof claim are grouped into one dependency_id only when they derive the same immediate source conclusion; all located sequences are retained in candidate_six_vertex_sequences.

R5_UNRESOLVED_P6_DEPENDENCY_CUTSET.minimality_definition: SOURCE_ORDER_PREFIX_CUTSET_V1: start at the current frozen C11 checkpoint and scan the audited source dependency DAG in topological/source order. Select an unresolved proof-critical node iff it is the first unresolved node on at least one still-unjustified route not already intercepted by an earlier selected node. Do not add a node whose every route from the current checkpoint is already intercepted by a selected predecessor. This is practical source-order minimality, not a claim of cardinality-optimal graph-cut computation.
R5_UNRESOLVED_P6_DEPENDENCY_CUTSET.why_it_cuts_current_routes: The frozen current C11 checkpoint is precisely the surviving acceptability Break-B state after the sealed Lemma5/6/7/10 transfer. Every audited route from this checkpoint into the later Paper-II normalization axioms and then Paper-I solver first requires the Lemma-11 acceptability conclusion. Therefore all later unresolved P6-sensitive nodes are downstream of this selected node for the current route.
R5_UNRESOLVED_P6_DEPENDENCY_CUTSET.important_nonimplication: A singleton current cutset does NOT mean Lemma 11 is the only P6 dependency and does NOT mean repairing Lemma 11 would prove a P7 lift. The inventory contains many later proof-critical P6 nodes that would become the next obligations if the current cut were ever discharged.
